mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 67 degrees and overcast at Verona Area High School under a Waning Gibbous moon, with an overnight low of 64 degrees and rain in the forecast.
The city is offering a 100 dollar rebate for residents who replace old toilets with high efficiency models, and please note that road maintenance on Lincoln Street begins August 4.
There is live music today at Bailey's Run, while tomorrow you can check out the Remote Area Medical clinic at the high school or the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree.
In a noteworthy call from last Friday, a 37-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I at 2:23 a.m.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Raspberry Cheesecake, and they are open until 10:30 PM. You can also grab a treat from the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today until 4:30 PM.
